description: lib.rs:151,156,215,219,274,278,315,319 — All four Profile impls return &str from id() and version(), but these methods only ever return &'static str string literals. Clippy (unnecessary_literal_bound) flags this: the lifetime is unnecessarily tied to &self. Fix: change the return types to &'static str in each impl. Note: if Profile trait in pkix-path also uses &str, the trait signature must be updated first (or the impls can use &'static str, which is covariant). The trait change in pkix-path would be the proper fix; that is a separate issue for pkix-path.
title: [rusty/pkix-profiles] unnecessary_literal_bound on id()/version() impls
